verdict.rationale: Data region or residency choice is a fair question for a cloud accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any option to choose where data is stored. The only storage-related statements say data and receipts are "backed up to the cloud" and "always available," which says nothing about region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
